standard_prerequisites.name: The commutation of the sheaf of homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module with filtered colimits, and the compatibility of global sections with directed colimits under a finiteness hypothesis on the coverings
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 4068-4070) as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter and a cross-chapter pointer
standard_prerequisites.use: Identify the colimit of the sheaves of homomorphisms with the sheaf of homomorphisms into the colimit and then take global sections.

core_obligations: Reformulate as sections: writing the two sides of the equality as the global sections of the sheaf of homomorphisms from the module into the colimit and into the terms of the system, the proof reduces the statement to an identification of sheaves (proof lines 4059-4067)

Identify the sheaves: by the corresponding statement for sheaves of homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module, the sheaf of homomorphisms into the colimit is the colimit of the sheaves of homomorphisms into the terms (proof lines 4068-4069)
Take sections: the lemma on global sections of directed colimits, applied under the hypothesis on the cofinal system of coverings, gives the displayed equality (proof lines 4069-4070)
proof_roadmap: 记 H = Hom_{O_X}(G, colim F_i)、H_i = Hom_{O_X}(G, F_i)，则两边的 Hom_X 分别是 Γ(X,H) 与 Γ(X,H_i)（按定义）。
由 lemma-hom-finite-presentation-colimit（G 有限表现）得 H = colim H_i；再由跨章的「有向 colim 的整体截面」引理（用假设 (3) 的有限覆盖与准紧交）即得 colim_i Hom_X(G,F_i) = Hom_X(G, colim_i F_i)。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module commute with filtered colimits, under a hypothesis on the existence of a cofinal system of finite coverings with quasi-compact intersections (author lemma at source lines 4034-4056, label lemma-finite-presentation-quasi-compact-colimit). The proof (source lines 4058-4071) reformulates both sides as global sections of sheaves of homomorphisms, uses the corresponding statement for sheaves of homomorphisms out of a finitely presented module to identify those sheaves, and then takes global sections using the compatibility of sections with directed colimits under the covering hypothesis (proof lines 4059-4070). The two-step reduction through the sheaf of homomorphisms is the content. H2.
